expression: log1p(count / whole-nucleus count total * 10000), independently for fractional corrected and original integer counts.
contrast: Cluster minus all other retained CMs in the same age and original library; require >=30 nuclei in each group. Summary is equal-weight mean over eligible libraries; both-library flags require two eligible libraries. No p-values or biological-replicate inference.
QC_sensitivity: Within-library expression residuals after linear removal of log total RNA, log detected genes, contamination, mitochondrial fraction and cycling-marker count. May remove genuine biological mediators; conditional sensitivity only.
core_sensitivity: Repeat contrasts using only original core ventricular nuclei, preserving original clusters. Some reference-rich clusters become ineligible.
selection_limits: Existing groups were interpreted using Slit2/Mpped2/Gja5/Etv1 panel and historical conduction-associated gates; these genes and related markers are not independent validation. No cell identity changed.
matrix_files: Sparse NPZ count matrices: rows in cell_metadata.tsv.gz order, columns in gene_mapping.tsv order. Only 17 selected features, not full transcriptome. Corrected counts remain fractional.
